scope: Pure journal parser and injected read-result controls. No engine, storage, crash, SSI, service, or container.

cases.name: truncated_final_marker
cases.meaning: Original parser treats an incomplete record as aborted. This does not establish an original-run torn append.

cases.name: injected_read_error
cases.input: Err(PermissionDenied), injected without chmod or real filesystem access
cases.meaning: A recorded error differs from a valid empty journal even though the original oracle returns the same flags.

cases.name: merged_partial_marker_then_commit
cases.meaning: Legacy parser accepts suffix c on merged line, losing one index. Audit flags wrong field count; no repair and no cause attribution.

cases.name: merged_unterminated_commit_then_abort
cases.meaning: Merged status c2 is invalid; legacy suffix parser returns false. Audit only; no cause attribution.

minimal_future_proof: Under separate authorization, exercise only the existing parse expression on these inputs and audit the injected Result error path. Assert exact old flags and rejection/error annotation. Do not add a recovery fix or count this as a cause demonstration.
execution: NONE: these are specified expectations, not results; no parser/control code was run.
